resources.string: A storage box that is not
Your DeKoi looks like a storage box for photos and backups, but holds nothing of value. Your own devices have no reason to use it, so nothing should ever touch it.
When something touches it, you know
If a device on your network tries to open your DeKoi or sign in to it, your phone gets an alert, usually within seconds. It says which device it was.
Each alert says in plain words what happened and how much it matters, then gives numbered steps, such as finding the device. Technical details are folded away below.
Your DeKoi also looks out for a device pretending to be your router, a copy of your Wi-Fi, and devices it has not seen before. When your DeKoi notices something, it tells you.
